scripts.db:psql: docker compose --env-file .env.postgres -f compose.local.yml exec postgres psql -U bax -d bax
scripts.release:check: pnpm prod:template:check && pnpm media:inventory && pnpm db:import:check
scripts.prod:logs: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml logs -f app migrate postgres nginx certbot
scripts.media:check: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile media run --rm media-import
scripts.media:import: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile media run --rm media-import --apply
scripts.media:audit: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile media run --rm media-audit
scripts.rehearsal:data:check: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile rehearsal run --rm data-import --publish
scripts.rehearsal:data:import: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile rehearsal run --rm data-import --apply --publish
scripts.rehearsal:media:check: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile media run --rm media-import
scripts.rehearsal:media:import: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile media run --rm media-import --apply
scripts.rehearsal:audit: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile media run --rm media-audit
scripts.rehearsal:revalidate: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile rehearsal run --rm cache-revalidate
scripts.backup:up: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile backup up -d --build backup
scripts.backup:now: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile backup-tools run --rm backup-once
scripts.backup:list: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile backup-tools run --rm --no-deps backup-once restic snapshots
scripts.backup:verify: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile restore run --rm restore
scripts.ssl:init: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml --profile ssl run --rm certbot-init && docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yml up -d --force-recreate nginx
